b: Before talking about Vietnam I need to talk about Vietnamese money.. Because from now on I'll be talking in lakhs.. And then you mustn't think I've got crores stashed away, right..One Sri Lankan rupee is about 80 Vietnamese dong here .. One lakh dong is 1250 Sri Lankan rupees.. Keep that in mind
The place we landed is called Ho Chi Minh.. They named the city after their old president himself.. Not like our people .. Seems he did a lot of good for the country

As soon as we arrived we got a car.. Here there's something called Grab, like our Uber.. Very cheap .. But there are no autos here at all .. Just cars and motorbikes.. The moment it came, the driver himself put all our bags in the car.. And a nice, big, smart car too (don't know what model.. I can't even tell the models of cars here in Colombo.. These are cars I've never seen in my life.. look it up online)

Here vehicles drive on the other side, like America.. At first it looks really strange.. But when we crossed the road, we looked the other way and nearly got hit.. Then, having got used to it, I nearly got hit again back in Colombo.. God saved me
Without autos the roads are a bit calmer… but there are no traffic police.. Everyone drives like a demon.. The motorbike guys are even more terrifying.. Seems they make up for there being no autos..

A lovely town.. Not like Colombo .. Only now and then could you see a tall building.. We got to the hotel in a flash.. But the hotel was tucked a bit inside.. We found it because Sing Keeth came and stood waiting .. You can't find it by the name

As soon as we got there we started eating.. My food story is a separate story .. I'll tell it later.. Food in Vietnam is very tasty.. If you go, definitely try everything.. If you're vegetarian, unless you're like me and you'll eat leaves and greens, you'll live well
After eating, the moment we went to the room the tiredness hit
We were supposed to look around Ho Chi Minh.. But terribly tired .. And since we had to catch another flight in the evening, we didn't go anywhere

Apparently right behind our hotel there's something called Walking Street.. That's where you can see and enjoy the city's night life.. Even better if boys go on their own, apparently.. That's what the three who'd seen it kept saying.. I wasn't too bothered .. It was Dhanush who vowed he'd go and see it, even if it had to be in Thailand

Since I like going to temples, Mithra said she'd take me to the Muthu Mariamman temple there.. A temple in Vietnam built in Dravidian architecture… but worship there now happens the Buddhist way.. I was tired so I didn't go.. Since she's an Amman across the sea she probably didn't keep count.. If it were here, she'd have had me beaten up somewhere for thinking of going and not coming
So I lay down, and when I got up, the run for the next flight
note: Ho Chi Minh is spoken in Tamil as "Ko Chi Min". A lakh is 100,000 and a crore ten million. Amman is the Tamil mother goddess.
